title: Politics and peek-a-boo in Australian parliament as senator brings baby to work
description: Senator Lidia Thorpe kept 6-month-old Aaliyah entertained, as her mum Senator Fatima Payman, participated in an online safety bill debate.
text: Australian Senator Fatima Payman brought her baby daughter, Aaliyah, to a parliamentary vote on holding social media platforms accountable for online harms.
While the lawmaker was speaking, baby Aaliyah captured the attention of Senator Lidia Thorpe and enjoyed a game of peek-a-boo.

Payman made history when she became the first hijab-wearing woman elected to Australia's Parliament in 2022, and the first sitting senator from Western Australia to give birth while in office, in 2026.
